text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The morning of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) had arrived—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Trainer, that ribbon...
choice_data_list: Yeah. I was thinking of picking up the pace from here on out.
Yeah. I was thinking we'd pick up the pace from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I tied the yellow ribbon I got from Buena Vista the other day loosely around my wrist like a bracelet.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
It tickles a little.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "I brought the fountain pen you gave me too. I made a special charm pouch just for it!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I'm all fired up!
...Treating today as a fresh start, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Because I realized there's no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I can do this. I'll reach that breathtaking view...
Because everyone is always watching over me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay.
I won't make a mistake ever again."
choice_data_list: That's right, you're not alone. Even out on the turf.
Right, you're not alone. Even on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
choice_data_list: ...I'll be waiting in the winner's circle!
...I'll be waiting in the winner's circle!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'll come running
right to where you are!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista raises a small fist in front of her chest.
I bump my fist against hers in response—
her yellow ribbon swaying as she does.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse was filled with intense heat.
—Just like any other year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected, Buena Vista took 1st in "The 1st," huh?
Normally, I'd have voted for her too, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, I get why you're feeling conflicted.
Now, who should I root for...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the overheated frenzy of before,
the cheers for Buena Vista were just a tiny bit... more composed.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Buena Vistaaa!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, Buena-san!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-chaaaan!!"
"We're cheering for you today too!!"
"Give it your all, Buena Vista!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...The same ardent expectations as always.
But now... everyone's faces come to mind.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. I'm not alone.
Everyone is fighting alongside me... carrying their hopes and expectations.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(I want to answer every single hope.
Every single ounce of love...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you all
for your support!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I betrayed everyone's hopes the other day...
I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“Still... starting today, from this day on...
I'll give it my all with a fresh state of mind.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Please, bear witness!
To Buena Vista's run...!
